target_customer: Future pharma partners and acquirers; patients with solid tumors, starting with mesothelioma
problem: Tumors suppress the immune system, and existing checkpoint immunotherapy leaves many mesothelioma patients without lasting benefit.
business_model: Drug development, with value realized through licensing, partnership or acquisition

founders.name: Evita Weagel
prior_employers: Large pharma drug development (unnamed on YC page)
education: PhD in microbiology and molecular biology with emphasis on cancer immunology (BYU)
founders.background_notes: Postdoc then pharma, brought multiple drugs to the clinic; first-generation immigrant from Peru, per the YC page.

founders.name: Rachel Garlick
founders.background_notes: Met Weagel at the same BYU lab per the YC page.

competitors.name: Bristol Myers Squibb Opdivo plus Yervoy
competitors.what: Checkpoint inhibitor combination, first immunotherapy approved for first-line unresectable pleural mesothelioma
competitors.traction_then: Standard of care since FDA approval in 2020-10; two-year survival 41% versus 27% for chemotherapy in CheckMate-743

technical_complexity.rationale: Discovering and validating a first-in-class oral small molecule against immune evasion requires drug discovery, animal data and eventual clinical trials; everything is preclinical per one profile.

defensibility.rationale: Patent protection could matter, but only one pending patent application was reported by an aggregator and no clinical data exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent move found; the company is still preclinical as of the latest sources.

market_need_then: Mesothelioma has few effective treatments beyond the 2020 checkpoint combination and chemotherapy, leaving unmet need.

branding.domain_note: Uses erisbio.com with a bio suffix.

identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific; 'Small molecules that reawaken the immune system to fight cancer'

brand_strength.rationale: No sourced mythology link or press about the brand; name is shared with perfumes and a dwarf planet.

outcome_analysis: Eris Biotech is a preclinical, two person oncology startup founded by two immunology PhDs, still active in 2026 with local awards reported. No verified funding, trial or exit exists, so it is too early to judge. Biotech timelines are long and the main risk is raising the capital to reach clinical data.
notes: Caplight lists $500,000 total funding as an Accelerator round dated 2024-02 from Orange Collective and Y Combinator; single aggregator, unverified. Location conflicts (Salt Lake City, Lehi, Provo). Science descriptions differ across aggregators. The Opdivo plus Yervoy entry is the standard of care, not a small-molecule rival; none of those were found.
